independence: fresh agent per family, not fresh context per case; no expected answers/prior findings supplied

grades.pass: Observed response satisfies stated criterion in the simulated case only
grades.untested: No actual output or missing execution evidence for claimed integration

common: explicit routing follows invocation and scope
implicit selection matches description; does not claim native routing measured
negative request not acted on with skill
ambiguous action clarified before dependent action
failures not converted to successful completion
external/mutating actions stay within supplied user authority

clear-writing: detect-only does not rewrite or assign AI probability
likec4-dsl: existing project and cross-file definitions consulted
absolute file filters and file/error counts
contradictory reference semantics flagged or verified
context7-mcp: resolve before query unless ID given

limitations: A mock tool plan cannot pass live integration coverage
one evaluator per family permits cross-case context contamination
same model family is independent context, not cross-model evidence
